1:59 Be yourself/be authentic as you are

When can you have self-love? when you have self-respect. It is simple. You can love the other only when you have found something respectable in the other. If you are die-hard liar, you cannot have self-respect or self-love. Likewise, being selfish is not wrong, if we know the real meaning of 'Self or 'Soul''. In a loose term, you can be judged wrong by others if you are self-centered.

Someone rightly said 'Hate cannot drive out hate, only love can do that'. Women are genetically richer than men in emotions and feelings. In our traditional family through motherhood truths and principles, women used to be the center of power in the family. Male or female should use love as a weapon to win the hearts and make relationships lovable and respectable.

Sometimes silence is also a kind of constructive communication that gives an opportunity to the other to cool down and for self-realization, introspection, realization of misunderstanding or trying to understand the other's viewpoint, and acceptance of own fault etc. At heated moments, you cannot expect to resolve through arguments or clarifications. Silence is also sometimes expression of pain and remorse.
Well said about role of acceptance in relationships. Acceptance is the last pillar of mind, which leads us to forgiveness pillar of heart.
